summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of the redesigned DelDOT DMV Casework dashboard. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass covering /api/stats new shape (80 cases, 3-class by_class with insufficient_information, priority bands, priority_bins length 10, confidence_bins, avg_confidence, 6-key changes, evidence_coverage 5 keys, evidence_strength), /api/cases new schema (prob_insufficient_information, confidence, evidence_strength, previous snapshot, nested evidence, explanations) with all filters (predicted_class, priority_band critical/high/medium/low, phase T0/T1, evidence_strength), /api/cases/{id} 404, PATCH with all three reviewer actions (marked_for_review, cleared, info_requested) writing audit snapshot, /api/audit list + single fetch, /api/model/performance metrics + 3x3 confusion + per_class + calibration + comparison, and CSV export→import round-trip (80/0). Frontend: All 9 sidebar items render, sidebar toggle works, TopHeader (page-title, global-search, phase-selector with T0/T1, dataset-status, notifications, profile) present, Decision Support Only disclaimer-banner visible on every page. Dashboard shows all six KPI cards (kpi-total=80, warranted, not-warranted, insufficient, high, conf) plus donut, priority-bar, changes-list, confidence chart, evidence-coverage. Queue filters + Category /warranted page (class filter correctly hidden) render, Case Detail shows candidate id/class badge/status badge/T0-T1 comparison/evidence-timeline/all 5 evidence-<type> cards/reviewer-notes/save-notes and action buttons; Marked for Review action logs to audit and shows toast. Analytics, Model Performance, Audit History (modal opens with snapshot), Import/Export (dropzone/upload/reset/export-download) all functional.

issues: Recharts logs repeated 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on first render before ResponsiveContainer measures its parent. Cosmetic only, charts render correctly after resize.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby — a11y warning only.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts initial width(-1) warning by giving ResponsiveContainer a minWidth/minHeight or wrapping in a fixed-height div that has non-zero size at mount.
(Optional) Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to audit-modal for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CSV import path re-generates a random case from candidate_id hash rather than preserving CSV field values — round-trip preserves candidate_id count but not the actual per-case values. Fine for the current mock demo, but if a real ingestion is expected the import should map the CSV columns onto the persisted document.

server.py stats mapping for 'changes' handles ii→(w/nw), w↔nw, and any→ii, but transitions like review_warranted→insufficient_information & review_not_warranted→insufficient_information fold into the generic 'to_ii' bucket while w↔nw transitions consume theirs first — logic is currently correct but tight; add unit coverage if this becomes user-facing.
server.py file is only ~480 lines — under the 700 threshold, OK. Consider splitting seed generation into a separate module if it grows further.
Case list endpoint returns {cases, total} object rather than a plain array as the spec wording implies; frontend uses .cases so no functional issue (already flagged in iteration_1).
seed_data_creation: test_api.py fixture calls POST /api/cases/reset before the suite to guarantee 80 fresh seeded cases; PATCH tests create audit entries with prefix TEST_ in reviewer_notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated against the new insufficient_information schema and 80-case seed. Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright including sidebar collapse, all 9 nav routes, KPIs, filters, case detail actions, audit modal, and import/export controls. Only cosmetic Recharts + Radix a11y console warnings remain; no functional bugs found.
